license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado who does not hold a license to practice medicine issued by the Colorado medical board pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 or a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290.

issuing_authority.quote: a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290

name.quote: "Board" means the Colorado podiatry board established pursuant to section 12-290-105.

type.quote: "Board" means the Colorado podiatry board established pursuant to section 12-290-105.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least twenty-one years of age

degree_required.value: four-year course of podiatry from an approved school
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a school of podiatry at which not less than a two-year prepodiatry course and a four-year course of podiatry is required and that is recognized and approved by the board

accrediting_body.quote: recognized and approved by the board

required.quote: Has completed one year of a residency program approved by the board as established by rules promulgated by the board

duration.quote: Has completed one year of a residency program approved by the board

kind.quote: residency program approved by the board

exams.name: Board-approved examination
exams.quote: Has passed an examination approved by the board as established by rules promulgated by the board

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) examination
exams.quote: Passed the part I and part II examinations by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners or its successor organization

required.quote: The board shall set reasonable continuing education requirements for the renewal of a license, but in no event shall the board require more than fourteen hours' credit of continuing education per year.

hours_per_period.quote: but in no event shall the board require more than fourteen hours' credit of continuing education per year

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of podiatry in this state to any applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

exists.quote: "Board" means the Colorado podiatry board established pursuant to section 12-290-105.

national_certification.quote: Is certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado who does not hold a license to practice medicine issued by the Colorado medical board pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 or a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290.

credential_type.quote: a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado who does not hold a license to practice medicine issued by the Colorado medical board pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 or a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290.

title_protection.quote: A person shall not advertise in any form or hold himself or herself out to the public as a podiatrist, or, in any sign or any advertisement, use the word "podiatrist", "foot specialist", "foot correctionist", "foot expert", "practipedist", "podologist", or any other terms or letters indicating or implying that the person is a podiatrist or that the person practices or holds himself or herself out as practicing podiatry or foot correction in any manner, without having, at the time of so doing, a valid, unsuspended, and unrevoked license as required by this article 290.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado who does not hold a license to practice medicine issued by the Colorado medical board pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 or a license to practice podiatry issued by the Colorado podiatry board as provided by this article 290.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception in applying for or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception, or making a misleading omission, in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice podiatry in this state or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime that would constitute a violation of podiatry laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this article 290

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of podiatry any person not licensed to practice podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in the practice of podiatry any person not licensed to practice podiatry or any person whose license to practice podiatry is suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry as partner, agent, or employee of unlicensed person or in unauthorized business structure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing podiatry as: The partner, agent, or employee of, or in joint venture with, any person who does not hold a license to practice podiatry within this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of podiatry laws or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 290

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of federal or state law regulating possession, distribution, or use of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or mental health disorder affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to: Notify the board of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral or mental health disorder that affects the podiatrist's ability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or abuse of health insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months following patient care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or during the six-month period immediately following the termination of such care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure in the course of patient care beyond the podiatrist's training and competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure in the course of patient care beyond the podiatrist's training and competence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests, treatment, or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any of the following activities and practices: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or repeatedly failing to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to complete and submit the renewal questionnaire or falsifying information on it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to complete and submit the renewal questionnaire, or failing to report all of the relevant facts, or falsifying any information on the questionnaire as required pursuant to section 12-290-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known to have violated podiatry laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known to have violated or, upon information or belief, believed to have violated any of the provisions of this subsection (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or compensation or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or compensation or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person as prohibited by section 12-290-122

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board within thirty days any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing agency in another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report the surrender of a license or authorization to practice in another state while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or the surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions of workers' compensation law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the provisions of section 8-42-101 (3.6)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of provisions regarding unlicensed persons operating ionizing radiation equipment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of section 12-290-202 or any rule of the board adopted pursuant to that section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-290-113

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline for acts related to the practice of podiatry in another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The discipline of a licensee for acts related to the practice of podiatry in another state, territory, or country shall be deemed unprofessional conduct

definition_quote.value: Holding out one's self to the public as being able to treat, prescribe for, palliate, correct, or prevent any disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf, by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment, including complications thereof consistent with the scope of practice
definition_quote.quote: Holding out one's self to the public as being able to treat, prescribe for, palliate, correct, or prevent any disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf, by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment, including complications thereof consistent with the scope of practice

methods_authorized.quote: by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe medications related to the scope of podiatric medicine, subject to limitations on opioids and benzodiazepines
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice, which includes only prescriptions related to the scope of podiatric medicine

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf

amputation_authorized.quote: The "practice of podiatry" does not include the amputation of the foot or the administration of an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic.

anesthesia_authority.quote: The "practice of podiatry" does not include the amputation of the foot or the administration of an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgical procedures on the ankle below the level of the dermis may be performed by a podiatrist licensed before July 1, 2010, in this state who: Is certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Surgical procedures on the ankle below the level of the dermis may be performed by a podiatrist licensed on or after July 1, 2010, in this state who: Is certified in reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery or foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization; Is performing surgery under the direct supervision of a licensed podiatrist certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization; except that, if the supervising podiatrist is licensed on or after July 1, 2010, the supervising podiatrist shall be certified in reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery or foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization; Is performing surgery under the direct supervision of a person licensed to practice medicine and certified by the American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery or its successor organization or by the American Osteopathic Board of Orthopedic Surgery or its successor organization; or Has completed a three-year surgical residency approved by the board.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: A podiatrist may only treat a soft tissue wound below the mid-calf if the patient is being treated by a physician for his or her underlying medical condition or if the podiatrist refers the patient to a physician for further treatment of the underlying medical condition.

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: A podiatrist may only treat a soft tissue wound below the mid-calf if the patient is being treated by a physician for his or her underlying medical condition or if the podiatrist refers the patient to a physician for further treatment of the underlying medical condition.

board_certification_body.quote: Is certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: Neither a podiatric physician nor a podiatrist shall allow any unlicensed person to operate a machine source of ionizing radiation or to administer radiation to any patient unless the person has met the standards then in effect under rules adopted pursuant to this section.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado unless the person purchases and maintains professional liability insurance as follows: If the person performs surgical procedures, professional liability insurance shall be maintained in an amount not less than one million dollars per claim and three million dollars per year for all claims.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A physician assistant licensed pursuant to article 240 of this title 12 may perform acts that constitute the practice of podiatry to the extent and in the manner authorized by rules promulgated by the board.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Be construed to prohibit the recommending, advertising, fitting, adjusting, or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports, or similar mechanical appliances and foot remedies by retail dealers and manufacturers

electronic_prescribing_required.quote: on and after July 1, 2021, a prescriber shall prescribe a controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), that is included in schedule II, III, or IV pursuant to part 2 of article 18 of title 18, only by electronic prescription transmitted to a pharmacy
